requirements.requirement: Shows its purpose with sewing-type contents
requirements.evidence: No sewing-specific props exist in the catalogue, so staged with the closest stand-ins: tape measure and tweezers in the open bin, a tape roll and small-parts heaps in the divided bins (prop:1,2,3,4,5,6) — all visible from above (look polar 10). Real thread spools, scissors and fabric are yours to drop in.

finish.summary: Built a three-cell sewing-supplies caddy: a full-depth 3-compartment bin for spools and taller tools, an open full-depth bin for bulkier kit (tape measure shown), and a shallow 2-compartment bin for buttons, pins and notions. The cluster is capped and joint-bolted as one tidy unit, staged with tape, tweezers and small-parts heaps so the layout reads at a glance. Total: 18 parts.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
